C0924.title: Police Across China Bust Recruitment Scams Impersonating Internet Companies
C0924.summary: In May 2022, police in multiple regions reported busting recruitment scams impersonating internet companies such as Douyin, Ele.me, and Meituan. Fraud rings posted fake job ads on WeChat and QQ groups, luring job seekers with roles like 'like agents' or 'order placers' that were actually a front for brushing scams.
